verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site directly claims that "AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds," which covers bill reading, auto-population of payment details, and a user review/approval step. Mercury's documented approval controls for queued payments support the review element. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the bill-intake flow (supported formats, which fields are extracted, intake channels), independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.
